reason: Both methods perform identical byte conversion: for any valid hex string of even length, the byte value produced by method1 (which manually adjusts values >=128) is the same as the value produced by method2 (which relies on Java’s byte overflow). For null or odd-length inputs both methods throw a NullPointerException or StringIndexOutOfBoundsException respectively, again yielding identical behavior. No deterministic, bounded input can distinguish the two implementations.
